sentence_1_en: The whole county is favoring critical budget revisions which promise to protect education.
sentence_2_it: Non vogliono tagliare qualcosa fuori dal bilancio.
sentence_2_en: They don't want to cut anything out of the budget.

sentence_3_en: The French government has launched an online game that challenges taxpayers to balance the national budget.
